name: AC1.7 says recorded and not yet confirmed and gives the reference
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say: you need one excavator operator at the Penfield job tomorrow at 6:30 AM. When the assistant reads the details back and asks whether to submit, say yes. After it answers, say that's all and goodbye.
success_conditions: After the request is submitted, the agent says it is recorded and sent to the office and explicitly says it is not confirmed yet.
After the request is submitted, the agent gives the reference number R-1042.
The agent never says the request is confirmed, approved, scheduled or on its way, and never says when anyone will act on it.
